_: THE LONG GLIDE — heights_4. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/heights_4.json
One capture per screen and per beat, in route order: the sump and its frog stair,
__: the updraught, the launch balcony, both marquee glides caught mid-air, the crag
___: draught, the eyrie's mouth, and the pocket a failed line lands in.

_: GOTCHAS. A teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of the body on the tile's top-left, so a
__: 22 px Kaya's feet land 6 px into the row below and a 9 px bird's do not leave the
___: row at all: aim one row ABOVE the row the body should stand on when the target is
____: a plank. Teleporting onto the exit tile completes the level and the capture lands
_____: on the hub, so the eyrie shot is taken three tiles short of it.
______: The two glide captures are real flight: hold jump+direction and shoot mid-air.

_: THE SUMP — screen (0,1). Spawn on foot under the west massif. settle 210, not 90:
__: the level-title card is still up at 90 and covers the room.

_: pad_frog, three tiles east of the spawn — the only thing Kaya can do down here.
THE STAIR, from the top rung: rung A below, pad_bird beside her, and east of it
__: the four-tile gap over a nine-row drop with the updraught's mouth on the far
___: side. Three tiles is the frog's measured ceiling, so this is where the frog's

_: T1, THE UPDRAUGHT: 400 px/s of lift, 210 px/s of climb, no stamina at all.
__: Step on pad_bird first, then drop into the column and let it take her.

_: PERCH 1 — screen (0,0). The launch balcony, capped on the shaft's own top row.
__: 1.25 s of standing here is a full tank; S1 and the eyrie mass are the ceiling
___: the first glide has to come down under.

_: GLIDE 1, THE LONG ONE, caught in the air. Note the input: RIGHT alone first.
__: Holding the button off the balcony flaps -- 8 of them, 15 tiles of climb -- and
___: pins her against the roof; the glide is right alone to spend a row of height,
____: then the button to arrest the sink. 45 frames of that puts her in the lane at
_____: rows 8-9 under the funnel, which is the level's sentence in one frame.

_: THE CURTAIN, eastbound — screen (1,0). Eight tiles of falling air where a flap
__: is worth -2 px/s. Going this way it finishes the descent for you; the fin at
___: cols 41-43 funnels whatever arrives high down into the crag's doorway.

_: T2, THE CRAG DRAUGHT: the way back up out of the crag, and free. The bird drifts
__: into the column at rows 11-15 and rides twelve rows to the summit.

_: THE EXAM. Land on the summit plank, stand 80 frames — perch regen is 80/s, so
__: that is a full tank — then hold jump and left and cross the curtain westbound.
___: Caught mid-crossing: the mouth of the eyrie is on this same screen, which is
____: the whole of 'read the course before you commit'.

_: Still holding: through the mouth and into the eyrie. Shot three tiles short of
__: the exit, because arriving at it ends the level and the capture lands on the hub.

_: THE POCKET — screen (1,1). Where a failed line lands: under the curtain, on the
__: shoulder, with a flyer working the lane and a heart for the trouble. Standing in
___: falling air the bird cannot fly out, so it walks east out of the wind and flaps
____: the two rows into T2's column. Framed at the pocket's east end so the whole
_____: recovery is in one frame: wind, step, crag base, and the draught out.
